definitions.gloss: historic site, historical ruins, historic monument
definitions.explanation: A site of historical significance, such as ancient ruins, castle remains, battlefields, or other places where important historical events occurred. In Japan, can also refer to officially designated cultural properties.

examples.japanese: {史跡|しせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城跡|しろあと}→城跡：16199_shiroato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{史跡|しせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: These castle ruins are designated as a national historic site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数|かず}え⟦{切|き}れない→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{史跡|しせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Kyoto has an uncountable number of historic sites.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {史跡|しせき}{巡|めぐ}り (visiting historic sites, historic site tour)
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{史跡|しせき} (nationally designated historic site)
- {史跡|しせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (be designated as a historic site)
- {史跡|しせき}⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧ (historic site park)

USAGE:
In Japan's cultural property system, {史跡|しせき} is one of the official categories under the Cultural Properties Protection Act. Designated {史跡|しせき} receive legal protection. In everyday use, the word can refer to any historically significant location, whether officially designated or not.
